reasoning: This commit rewrote ApplicationContextRequestMatcher's matches() method, replacing the previous double-checked-locking pattern (which correctly synchronized initialization) with an AtomicBoolean.compareAndSet approach. The new code calls compareAndSet(false, true) which marks initialized=true before initialized(context) actually completes, then falls through to call matches() immediately. Under concurrency, this allows a second thread to see initialized flag already true (or race in) and call matches() concurrently while the first thread's initialized(context) call is still running — exactly the race condition described in gh-18211 that the fix commit resolves by using a synchronized block that only sets initialized=true after initialized(context) returns.
